description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different anomaly detection models, measured by the Area Under the Curve (AUC) percentage, as a function of the number of data points (N). The x-axis, labeled "N," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "AUC (%)", is also linear and ranges from 75% to 100%, with tick labels at intervals of 5%. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different model. The blue line starts at an AUC of approximately 95% at N=0, peaks at 100% at N=5, and then gradually declines to around 90% at N=20. The orange line begins at an AUC of about 85% at N=0, increases to 100% at N=5, and then decreases to around 90% at N=20. The green line starts at an AUC of approximately 90% at N=0, peaks at 100% at N=5, and then declines to about 85% at N=20. The red line begins at an AUC of around 85% at N=0, increases to 100% at N=5, and then decreases to about 90% at N=20. The purple line starts at an AUC of approximately 80% at N=0, peaks at 100% at N=5, and then declines to around 80% at N=20.
